title: OSCORE context cache diverges from spec 8.8: no 64-entry bound with LRU eviction (C/Rust fail-closed at 8, Python unbounded)
description: Requirement (spec/06-security.md:444-446): Implementations MUST bound OSCORE security contexts to at most 64 entries; on overflow MUST evict least-recently-used (LRU by last message timestamp). Classification: divergent. Evidence: C LICHEN_OSCORE_MAX_CONTEXTS default 8, range 2-32, fixed pool, no eviction code (lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/Kconfig:20-26, oscore_ctx.c:29, oscore_persist.c:427-429); Rust OwnershipRegistry<8> refuses new claims, no eviction (rust/lichen-oscore/src/ownership.rs:30-39, tests/ownership.rs:137 capacity_exhaustion_fails_closed); Python context stores unbounded (python/src/lichen/coap/secure/sqlite_store.py, memory_store.py). Suggested placement: lichen-oscore ownership/context registry, C Kconfig+pool, Python stores. Note: C/Rust fail-closed is stricter than spec (safe direction); Python unbounded is the real MUST violation. human-only: touches audited oscore context-management internals; do not plan a fix without human decision.
close_reason: Duplicate of b7z9.83. Decision recorded: oscore-context-bound.
